name: Automobile crash safety
payer: Insurers fund IIHS; government funds NCAP; manufacturers do not pay for ratings.
access: Independent purchase and testing of production vehicles.
ai_analogue: Insurer-funded, publicly rated, adversarial-to-the-manufacturer testing changed design without a mandate. The public-ratings model has no AI equivalent yet.

milestones.event: Insurance Institute for Highway Safety founded by insurers.
Unsafe at Any Speed and congressional hearings on auto safety.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Annual road deaths near 50,000 and rising

milestones.event: National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act; NHTSA formed 1970.
First Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.
IIHS begins publishing its own crash test ratings.

status: seed; secondary sources; verify each milestone against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Insurers (IIHS) and government (NCAP) buy production vehicles and publish ratings; manufacturers cannot opt out.
